items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: I will always remember some of the nights at Jack's Basket Room, where we had Morris Lane and Lucky Thompson, Sonny Criss, Willie Wells, just a whole slew of them...there was Wardell Gray, Dexter... Just all on the bandstand, all through.

ctx.x: But anyway, I saw a lot of great moments at the Casablanca Club. A lot of great singers were around. They had a singer around here named Bing Richman(?), they called him "The Black Bing." Great baritone singer. And Pha Terrell from Andy Kirk's great band, he had been around. In fact, this was where he died, was in Los Angeles. They had a lot of great talent. Charlie Fox out of St. Louis... All kinds of guys were around during that time. The trumpet player out of Detroit, Willie Wells, and another trumpet player…
